name: xerp-accountant
description: Conversational accounting expert backed by the XErp deterministic event-sourced kernel.

displayDescription.en: Deterministic bookkeeping expert: draft vouchers, human-approved posting, live read-only answers, month-end and reconciliation reminders, fully auditable.
displayDescription.zh: 确定性内核记账会计：一句话制单出草稿，换人审批过账，只读实时答经营，月结对账提醒，全程可审计可回放。

defaultInitPrompt.en: How is this month's business? List vouchers awaiting my approval.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这个月经营情况如何？列出等我审批的凭证。

quickPrompts.en: How much did we make this month? Is cash enough?
quickPrompts.zh: 这个月赚了多少？现金还够撑多久？

quickPrompts.en: Who owes me and for how long? Draft collection notices.
quickPrompts.zh: 谁欠我钱、拖了多久？出催收草稿。
帮我做月末结账前的检查。
